data.title: 菲伦 · 早期修行的烛光抄写
data.description: 【早期修行想象·烛光书房】为三级魔法使资格准备的夜晚，菲伦端坐在书桌前抄写古代符文。听见同行者放下热茶，她停住笔尖，轻轻点头致谢，另一手仍压着书页；木质法杖靠在墙边，烛光照亮她专注而安静的侧脸。
data.action: 在书房抄写符文时暂停笔尖、点头谢茶，另一手压住书页，法杖靠墙
data.promptProse: Fern pauses her quill above a copied rune diagram and nods thanks toward newly placed tea, her other hand holding the source book open. Black coat and high-collared white dress retain the chosen travelling clothes beneath half-up purple hair. The medium portrait includes a staff against the wall and shelves receding behind the study chair. Candlelight illuminates her calm eyes and paper, casting the quill's fine shadow beside the cup.
